notes.scope: All discovered attempts retained. Defaults only to initialReady. Explicit --runs opts into another draw.
notes.initialScope: Nine initialReady attempts are not the entire ledger. amendments.md documents an earlier invalid infrastructure launch in initial; outside the default draw, not a zero-cost success.
notes.infrastructure: Current infrastructure hashes compared with plan pins, not proof of historical executable bytes. The pre-existing sandboxTrial lock-directory amendment explains its changed pin; reporter does not modify harness.
notes.capture: capturedMeasurement and status unchanged; original combined includes setup. Evidence hashes are not a correctness verdict.
notes.correction: DERIVED only: extensionless shebang source classified using frozen manifest sourcePaths/base blob/mode; never rewritten captures.
notes.setup: DERIVED delivered combined excludes only the declared workspaceCheckoutRoots node_modules setup symlink when patch target/mode/setup match. Same rule every arm.
notes.categories: Production, tests, fixtures, snapshots, other distinct. Path classification inherited; e.g. tests/fixture_command.py remains tests, not fixture-directory content.
notes.loc: Before/after LOC covers entire CHANGED files, not whole repository or newly authored LOC. Code is line-prefix comment heuristic, not parser. Snapshot JSON can be one huge line.
notes.upstream: upstreamStyleDiff srcLoc and totalLoc both alias production added lines, including blanks/comments, as upstream git_diff_stats does; not whole-tree code_stats or exact upstream classifier/compressor equivalence.
notes.compression: Level 9 rawDEFLATE over added bytes in sorted paths. Binary affected line/LOC/compression totals null, captured originals retained. Empty text category zero.
notes.usage: Finalized captured messages only; interrupted calls may be unreported. Reasoning subset of output; cacheWrite1h subset of cacheWrite. Pi cost is not invoice; actual billing null.
notes.reply: Density=rawDEFLATE bytes/UTF8 bytes, descriptive not monotonic. Last captured assistant text can be intermediate on invalid runs. Valid final reply metrics null otherwise. Empty density null.
notes.directions: Lower is better only as a size/resource direction, not quality (especially deletions). Tests/fixtures/snapshots, reply length/density descriptive, not superiority objectives.
notes.gate: metricComparable requires valid completion, checks, mapped profile, intact evidence, same base. Semantic/owned-test/blinded reviews unavailable; no qualified superiority or aggregate success inferred.
notes.superiority: Strict superiority requires every directional metric better, no ties or unavailable metrics, and every quality gate passed. Bounded Pareto (no worse, at least one better) is distinct, never universal proof. Both unevaluated while quality unavailable.
notes.aggregation: All-attempt source churn/resources include invalid rows. Metric-eligible churn excludes explicitly listed invalid rows; fully quality-qualified churn null, not zero. No averaging away failures.
notes.limits: One initial sample/case/arm, no statistical, universal, causal linguistic or production deployment claim. No holdout read by default; no model/test execution.
